verdict.rationale: SolidJS uses JSX components that combine markup and logic in one function, integrates with standard CSS/JS tooling (Vite, TypeScript), and community reports confirm this component model works well in practice (e.g., react-bootstrap port, data viz use). missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc snippet showing CSS co-location patterns, and some community critiques note non-intuitive reactivity quirks (props-as-functions) that add friction to the 'code you already know' claim.
